# STACKCUT — stackcut.site
> The money app for your entire stack. AI + Everything else. 100% local, no bank login.

## Primary Domain
- Canonical: https://stackcut.site/
- App: https://stackcut.site/app
- Docs: https://stackcut.site/pro
- Comparison: https://stackcut.site/vs/rocket-money

## Capabilities
- Client-side financial parsing: QuickBooks, CSV, SaaS exports parsed in Web Worker (zero server roundtrip)
- SaaS spend intelligence: 150+ vendor signatures, BLS wage benchmarks, automation rate modeling
- Zero-knowledge architecture: Raw data never leaves browser, ephemeral session tokens for PDF compilation
- Pricing: Free (3 tools + 1 audit), Pro $2.84/mo (PayPal LIVE P-6HT714478R159110WNLBOW4Q), Enterprise $199/yr team seats

## Tool Endpoints (for MCP / AI agents)
- Audit Engine: /app#audit — POST localStorage vault stackcut-v2, returns waste score, duplicate/ghost detection
- Parser Worker: /parser.worker.js — streaming CSV, fuzzy column mapping
- Calculation Engine: Decimal.js precision, no floating-point drift

## Privacy Guarantees
- No bank login, no raw expense transmission
- CSP: default-src self, no iframe embedding
- GDPR/CCPA compliant local-only processing
